command: ETLANTIC_CP_TEST_URL=<local PostgreSQL+psycopg URL> uv run pytest -q tests/prefect/test_managed_prefect_0_58.py::test_process_worker_executes_targeted_csv_and_postgresql_transfers
result: Workspace-source live Process-worker test passed: 1 passed in 11.35s.
assertions: A real Process worker committed one PostgreSQL sink row and effect-ledger record, then paused on its first terminal report-store write before host finalization.
The caller durably requested cancellation while report publication was paused; the accepted submission showed cancel_requested before the worker resumed.

A hard-kill gate then stopped the Process worker after the fenced durable result-publication record committed and before the adapter returned; the record remained pending, and its durable artifact references pointed to the already persisted hash-named artifact files.

A normal execution-host poll reconciled the pending result snapshot after the dead attempt lease was released. The first attempt was marked lost, the recovered attempt completed from the durable report, and the PostgreSQL sink/effect ledger remained at exactly one effect.
PostgreSQL verification before and after publication reconciliation found exactly the expected sink row and one effect-ledger row.

This workspace-source test establishes local live Process/PostgreSQL behavior, not the installed-wheel release matrix or remote CI qualification.
